places.name: La Boca & Caminito Street
places.ai_summary: La Boca & Caminito Street is a well-known highlight in Buenos Aires, easy to add to most itineraries. Expect light walking and time for photos. Facilities are nearby, and signage is straightforward for first-time visitors. Pair this stop with nearby attractions to make logistics efficient. Weekdays are generally quieter than weekends during peak months.

opening_hours.notes: Area accessible 24/7, typical shop/attraction hours; verify locally

places.best_time_to_visit: Mar–May, Sep–Nov
places.place_tip: Go early to beat crowds; keep time buffer for photos. Take a relaxed pace, explore side streets, pause for photos, sample a local snack, and allow a small buffer for queues or brief weather changes along the way.
places.address: Caminito, La Boca, Buenos Aires, Argentina

places.name: Recoleta Cemetery
places.ai_summary: Recoleta Cemetery is a famous burial ground known for its ornate mausoleums and notable figures interred, including Eva Perón. A city within a city. Expect light walking on paved paths. Facilities nearby. Easy to add to most itineraries.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry usually 30-45 mins before closing; verify locally

places.best_time_to_visit: Mar–May, Sep–Nov
places.place_tip: Go early to beat crowds; consider a guided tour for historical context and finding specific tombs like Evita's.
places.address: Junín 1760, C1113 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: Recoleta montage
attribution.author: Bleff
attribution.description: Photo montage of the Buenos Aires district of Recoleta

places.name: Plaza de Mayo
places.ai_summary: Plaza de Mayo is Buenos Aires' main historic and political square, site of major national events. Surrounded by Casa Rosada, the Cabildo, and the Metropolitan Cathedral. Good for photos and orientation. Expect light walking.

opening_hours.notes: Public square; always accessible

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, daytime
places.place_tip: Go early for photos with fewer crowds. Visit on a Thursday afternoon (~3:30 PM) to potentially witness the weekly march of the Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo.
places.address: Plaza de Mayo, C1084 CABA, Argentina

places.name: Casa Rosada (Presidential Palace)
places.ai_summary: Casa Rosada, the Pink House, is the executive mansion and office of the President of Argentina, located on Plaza de Mayo. Famous for its color and balcony. Guided tours often available on weekends.

opening_hours.Saturday: Guided tours typically available (check website/book ahead)
opening_hours.Sunday: Guided tours typically available (check website/book ahead)
opening_hours.notes: Interior tours require advance booking, usually weekends only.

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round (exterior); Weekends for potential tours
places.place_tip: Book guided tours online well in advance. Best photos often from Plaza de Mayo. Check if the building is illuminated pink at night.
places.address: Balcarce 50, C1064 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: Casa Rosada exterior from Plaza de Mayo
attribution.author: Lars Curfs (Grashoofd)
attribution.description: Casa Rosada exterior from Plaza de Mayo. Shot in February 2014.

places.name: Teatro Colón
places.ai_summary: Teatro Colón is considered one of the world's best opera houses for its acoustics and stunning architecture. Offers performances (opera, ballet, concerts) and guided tours. Located near the Obelisco.

opening_hours.Monday: Tours often run, performance schedule varies
opening_hours.Tuesday: Tours often run, performance schedule varies
opening_hours.Wednesday: Tours often run, performance schedule varies
opening_hours.Thursday: Tours often run, performance schedule varies
opening_hours.Friday: Tours often run, performance schedule varies
opening_hours.Saturday: Tours often run, performance schedule varies
opening_hours.Sunday: Tours often run, performance schedule varies
opening_hours.notes: Check official website for tour times and performance calendar

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round for tours; performance season varies
places.place_tip: Book tours and performance tickets well in advance. Guided tours offer great insight into the building's history and architecture. Dress code may apply for performances.
places.address: Cerrito 628, C1010 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: Fachada del Teatro Colón en Buenos Aires, Argentina

places.name: Puerto Madero Waterfront
places.ai_summary: Puerto Madero is a redeveloped dockside area known for modern architecture, upscale dining, bars, and the iconic Puente de la Mujer bridge. Popular for walking, cycling, and enjoying river views. Expect light walking.

opening_hours.notes: Public area; businesses have own hours, busiest evenings/weekends

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, particularly pleasant evenings/nights
places.place_tip: Visit around sunset for nice views and atmosphere. Walk across the Puente de la Mujer. Can be more expensive than other neighborhoods. Check out the ecological reserve nearby.
places.address: Puerto Madero, Buenos Aires, Argentina

places.name: San Telmo Market
places.ai_summary: Historic covered market (Mercado de San Telmo) open daily with food stalls, produce, and some antiques. Famous for the sprawling Sunday street fair (Feria de San Telmo) on surrounding streets, featuring antiques, crafts, street performers, and tango.

opening_hours.notes: Indoor market hours daily; large street fair (Feria de San Telmo) on Sundays along Defensa street

places.best_time_to_visit: Sunday for the full fair experience; weekdays for a quieter market visit
places.place_tip: Carry small cash for street vendors. Explore side streets. Watch belongings, especially on busy Sundays. Great place to try street food and see tango.
places.address: Defensa 963, C1066 CABA, Argentina (Indoor Market)

attribution.title: San Telmo montage
attribution.author: Bleff

places.name_native: Mercado de San Telmo / Feria de San Telmo

places.name: Palermo Soho & Hollywood Districts
places.ai_summary: Trendy adjacent neighborhoods in Palermo known for boutiques, designer shops (Soho), restaurants, bars, cafes, and media companies (Hollywood). Excellent for strolling, shopping, dining, nightlife, and seeing street art.

opening_hours.Sunday: Area open 24/7; shop/restaurant hours vary (many open)
opening_hours.notes: Public neighborhoods; businesses have own hours, peak times are afternoons, evenings, and weekends

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, afternoons and evenings, especially weekends
places.place_tip: Explore the side streets like Jorge Luis Borges and Honduras. Great for people-watching at outdoor cafes. Check out Plaza Serrano (Plazoleta Julio Cortázar) on weekends for artisan stalls.
places.advanced_booking: Recommended for popular restaurants/bars, especially on weekends
places.address: Palermo Soho / Palermo Hollywood, Buenos Aires, Argentina

attribution.title: Palermo montage
attribution.author: Bleff
attribution.description: Photo montage of the Buenos Aires district of Palermo

places.name: Obelisco de Buenos Aires
places.ai_summary: The Obelisco is an iconic national monument at the intersection of Av. Corrientes and Av. 9 de Julio (one of the world's widest avenues). A major landmark and photo spot in the heart of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Public monument in Plaza de la República

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, day or night (lit up)
places.place_tip: Be cautious of traffic on Av. 9 de Julio. Good photo opportunities from the central reservation. Often the site of celebrations or protests.
places.address: Av. 9 de Julio s/n, Plaza de la República, C1043 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: Monserrat montage
attribution.author: Bleff
attribution.description: Photo montage of the Buenos Aires district of Monserrat

places.name: Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes
places.ai_summary: Argentina's National Museum of Fine Arts holds an extensive collection, featuring European masters (Rembrandt, Goya, Monet) and a comprehensive survey of Argentine art from the 19th century to the present.

opening_hours.notes: Check for holiday hours; last admission typically 30 mins before close

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, weekdays are generally quieter
places.place_tip: Admission is often free. Check for temporary exhibitions which might have a fee. Located in Recoleta, easy to combine with the cemetery.
places.address: Av. del Libertador 1473, C1425 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: Fachada del Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes (Argentina)
attribution.author: Ales bellasartes

places.name: Floralis Genérica Sculpture
places.ai_summary: Floralis Genérica is a large, modern steel flower sculpture located in Plaza de las Naciones Unidas. Its petals mechanically open during the day and close at night. A popular photo spot.

opening_hours.notes: Public sculpture in a park; petals usually open around 8 AM and close at sunset

places.best_time_to_visit: Daytime to see petals open, or sunset to see them close
places.place_tip: Located near the Recoleta neighborhood and the Fine Arts Museum. Check if the opening/closing mechanism is currently operational.
places.address: Plaza de las Naciones Unidas, Av. Pres. Figueroa Alcorta 2301, C1425 CABA, Argentina

places.name: Café Tortoni (Historic Café)
places.ai_summary: Café Tortoni is the oldest and most famous café in Buenos Aires, established in 1858. Known for its traditional atmosphere, stained glass, marble tables, and history (frequented by artists and intellectuals). Offers coffee, pastries, light meals, and tango shows.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary; tango show times differ, check website

places.suggested_duration: 1–1.5 hours (for coffee/snack); longer for tango show
places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round; mornings can be less crowded
places.place_tip: Expect queues, especially during peak hours. Try the 'chocolate con churros'. Book tango shows in advance.
places.address: Av. de Mayo 825, C1084 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: Avenida de Mayo Café Tortoni
attribution.author: Roberto Fiadone is the author of this work
attribution.description: Café Tortoni, en Avenida de mayo, Buenos Aires

places.name: Palacio Barolo
places.ai_summary: Palacio Barolo is a landmark office building noted for its unique architecture inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy. Offers guided tours explaining the symbolism (Hell, Purgatory, Heaven) and access to the lighthouse for panoramic city views.

opening_hours.notes: Access typically by guided tour only; booking essential

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round; evening tours offer city lights view
places.place_tip: Book tours online in advance. Choose a tour that includes lighthouse access for the best views. Not suitable for those with severe claustrophobia (tight spiral stairs to lighthouse).
places.sunset_time: Best from lighthouse on evening tours
places.address: Av. de Mayo 1370, C1085 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: Palacio Barolo 10
attribution.author: Eugenio Hansen, OFS

places.name: Planetario Galileo Galilei
places.ai_summary: Located in Parque Tres de Febrero (Bosques de Palermo), this planetarium offers astronomy shows, exhibits, and telescopes for public viewing (check schedule). Distinctive UFO-like architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Check official website for show schedules, exhibit hours, and telescope availability

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, check schedule for desired shows/events
places.place_tip: Shows are usually in Spanish. Book tickets online in advance, especially for popular shows or weekend visits. Enjoy the surrounding park before or after.
places.address: Av. Sarmiento s/n, C1425 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: Vista aérea del Planetario Galileo Galilei 06
attribution.author: ProtoplasmaKid
attribution.description: Aerial view obtained with a drone of the Galileo Galilei Planetarium, Palermo neighborhood of Buenos Aires, Argentina.

places.name: El Ateneo Grand Splendid (Bookstore)
places.ai_summary: Widely regarded as one of the world's most beautiful bookstores, El Ateneo Grand Splendid is housed in a converted grand theatre. Features original balconies, stage (now a cafe), and ceiling frescoes. A must-see for book lovers and architecture enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Verify hours locally, especially Sundays/holidays

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round; weekdays might be slightly less crowded
places.place_tip: Take photos from the upper balconies for the best views. Enjoy coffee or a snack at the cafe on the former stage. Browse the extensive book collection (mostly Spanish).
places.address: Av. Sta. Fe 1860, C1123 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: Yenny Ateneo Grand Splendid
attribution.author: Roberto Fiadone
attribution.description: Frente de la librería Ateneo Grand Splendid, Avenida Santa Fe 1860 (vereda sur), en Recoleta, Buenos Aires.

places.name: Museo Evita
places.ai_summary: Museum dedicated to the life and legacy of Eva Perón (Evita), located in a beautiful historic mansion in Palermo where Evita's foundation once operated. Exhibits cover her childhood, political career, fashion, and impact.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission usually 1 hour before closing; verify hours

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, weekdays might be less busy
places.place_tip: Audio guides are often available in multiple languages. The museum has a nice restaurant/cafe in the courtyard.
places.address: Lafinur 2988, C1425 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: ID 341 Casa Carabassa 0792
attribution.author: Carlos Zito
attribution.description: This is a photo of an Argentine monument identified by the ID

places.name: Japanese Garden (Jardín Japonés)
places.ai_summary: A tranquil oasis in Palermo featuring traditional Japanese landscaping, ponds with koi fish, bridges, a tea house, cultural center, and restaurant. Offers a peaceful escape from the city bustle.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary slightly, check website; last entry usually 30-45 mins before close

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round; spring (Sep-Nov) for potential blossoms
places.place_tip: Weekdays are less crowded. Check for cultural events or workshops. Enjoy tea or sushi at the restaurant (reservations might be needed).
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required for entry, but can buy online
places.address: Av. Casares 3450, C1425 CABA, Argentina

places.name: Costanera Sur Ecological Reserve
places.ai_summary: Large nature reserve on reclaimed land along the Río de la Plata. Offers walking and cycling trails through wetlands and grasslands, excellent for birdwatching and escaping the city noise. Views of the river and city skyline.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can change seasonally or due to weather; closes earlier in winter. Check official sources.

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round (avoid midday heat in summer); good weather days
places.place_tip: Rent bikes near the entrance or bring your own. Bring water, sunscreen, and insect repellent. Great spot for birdwatching and seeing capybaras and lizards.
places.address: Av. Tristán Achával Rodríguez 1550, C1107 CABA, Argentina (Main Entrance)

attribution.title: Reserva ecológica de Buenos Aires
attribution.author: Rcidte

places.name: La Recoleta Cultural Center
places.ai_summary: Adjacent to the famous cemetery, Centro Cultural Recoleta is a vibrant arts center housed in a former convent. Features contemporary art exhibitions, concerts, workshops, and events, often aimed at a younger audience. Has a distinctive terrace.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary for specific exhibitions or events; check website

places.best_time_to_visit: Afternoons/evenings when open
places.place_tip: Check the current exhibition and event schedule online. Admission is often free or low cost. Good place to see contemporary Argentine art.
places.advanced_booking: Usually not required for general entry
places.cost: Often Free (some events may have fees)
places.address: Junín 1930, C1113 CABA, Argentina

attribution.title: Recoleta montage
attribution.author: Bleff
attribution.description: Photo montage of the Buenos Aires district of Recoleta

places.name: Tigre Delta Boat Tour (Day Trip)
places.ai_summary: A popular day trip from Buenos Aires to the Tigre Delta, a network of rivers and islands. Boat tours navigate the waterways, showcasing island homes, stilt houses, lush vegetation, and a different way of life. Often combined with a visit to the town of Tigre.

opening_hours.notes: Requires travel to Tigre (train or bus approx 1hr); multiple tour operators exist with different schedules

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, warmer months (Sep-Apr) more pleasant
places.place_tip: Take the scenic train (Tren de la Costa) part of the way for better views. Choose a smaller boat ('lancha colectiva' or private) for a potentially more intimate tour of smaller channels. Bring insect repellent.
places.advanced_booking: Recommended, especially on weekends or for specific tours
places.address: Estación Fluvial Tigre (Main boat terminal), Tigre, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
